recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a dark, textured night sky over a dense, airbrushed cityscape. The central focus is a large, expressive script title with a multi-color neon gradient, flanked by structured sans-serif and serif secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant neon script contrasting against a deep black textured background
Horizontal division between the dark sky and the warm, glowing urban horizon
Juxtaposition of fluid, organic hand-lettering with rigid, geometric display type
coreInvariants: Tri-color gradient (Pink/Orange to Blue) within the main script
Stippled or airbrushed texture on the cityscape horizon
Heavy black negative space in the upper two-thirds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large script title dominates the center; secondary text at top and bottom margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow-to-pink gradient at the base of the central script.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top block text, flows down through the expressive script, and settles on the detailed cityscape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black space at the top provides breathing room for the vibrant lettering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background providing maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon pink, orange, and cyan for the primary lettering.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm red and gold stippling in the cityscape.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center and bottom, fading into zero value at the top.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted earth tones; stick to synthetic neon and deep blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive cursive script and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: Variable stroke width with heavy ink-bleed effect; long, sweeping descenders and ascenders.
Display: Ultra-condensed, heavy weight with minimal letter spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'B' and 'N' feature exaggerated loops and sharp, tapering tails.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, colorful script paired with a rigid, white geometric sans-serif for legibility.

preserve: The three-color gradient in the script
The ultra-condensed nature of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top display text.
Captures the 70s expressive energy of the central title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, textured black background. At the bottom third, create a dense cityscape silhouette with a heavy airbrushed glow in red, orange, and yellow, fading into the black sky with a stippled texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, expressive hand-drawn script in the center with a pink-to-blue gradient. Add a blocky, white, ultra-condensed sans-serif title at the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the script gradient vibrant and multi-tonal?
Is the cityscape texture grainy/airbrushed rather than photographic?
Is the top text sufficiently condensed and heavy?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
Unique hand-drawn ligatures in the script

mustAchieve: Seamless color transitions within the lettering
avoid: Generic cursive fonts without weight variation

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script does not look like a standard system font.
Check that the cityscape doesn't overwhelm the central text.
Verify the black background has a subtle paper or film texture.
Confirm the white text at the top is perfectly centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark textured void with a vibrant airbrushed horizon and overlay expressive, multi-colored neon script for a retro-urban aesthetic.
